goal: Keep readable Workshop source visible and continue bounded sequential article GET polling through retryable job failures until canonical publication or a terminal outcome, without scheduling another rewrite.
bounded_contexts: Bounded sequential reader polling and source fallback
acceptance_tests: Readable source remains published during failed/retryable=true, queued and rewriting updates; completed canonical ends polling once, without an additional prepare POST.
Retry-after and the existing 120000ms maximum absolute budget remain enforced; reads remain sequential and budget exhaustion returns the latest readable source.
Completed, needs_review, withdrawn, failed/retryable=false and failed with no retryable flag remain terminal; missing job_id remains inactive.
Navigation abort during retry backoff rejects the obsolete operation and prevents any later request or update.
Only the two literal implementation paths change; no payment, entitlement, backend retry ownership, source/media rights, acceptance inventory or release authority changes.
forbidden_scope: Any implementation path outside the exact two-file allowlist
Payment/checkout/entitlement, API/index hydration, engine labels, backend/provider/model scheduling or retry changes
Firebase SDK, media rights/tokens/renewal, browser fixtures, acceptance graphs, dependency/image/deadline changes
GitHub mutation by the gate completion agent; implementation commit/push before coordinator dispatch
Merge, deployment, cloud/secret/DNS operations, production-data changes or payments
